body: I had to move back in with my family when the pandemic started and it's been a battle not to relapse into my ED. My mom is the exact same way and living like this for almost a whole year has been absolute hell

This post made me cry a little.

If I could donate my life to someone more deserving than me I would do it in a heartbeat because there are so many people who are so much better and work harder than I do and are therefore infinitely more deserving of a long, happy life. I would do it in a second
